import { defineComponent, h } from 'vue'
import { ComboboxChips as UiComboboxChips, ComboboxInput as UiComboboxInput } from '@ui-sdk/vue/combobox'

import './combobox.css'

export {
  Combobox,
  ComboboxArrow,
  ComboboxChip,
  ComboboxChipRemove,
  ComboboxChipsOverflow,
  ComboboxClear,
  ComboboxContent,
  ComboboxCreate,
  ComboboxEmpty,
  ComboboxGroup,
  ComboboxGroupLabel,
  ComboboxItem,
  ComboboxItemIcon,
  ComboboxItemIndicator,
  ComboboxItems,
  ComboboxItemText,
  ComboboxLabel,
  ComboboxList,
  ComboboxSelectAll,
  ComboboxSeparator,
  ComboboxStatus,
  ComboboxTrigger,
  ComboboxValue,
  ComboboxValueIcon,
  createComboboxController,
} from '@ui-sdk/vue/combobox'

export type ComboboxAppearance = 'small' | 'base' | 'large'
export type ComboboxSurface = 'base' | 'layer-1' | 'invisible'
export type ComboboxItemProps<T = string> = Omit<
  BaseComboboxItemProps,
  'value' | 'class' | 'render'
> & {
  value: T
  class?: BaseComboboxItemProps['class']
  render?: BaseComboboxItemProps['render']
}
export type ComboboxChipProps<T = string> = Omit<
  BaseComboboxChipProps,
  'value' | 'class' | 'render'
> & {
  value: T
  class?: BaseComboboxChipProps['class']
  render?: BaseComboboxChipProps['render']
}

export const ComboboxInput = defineComponent({
  name: 'ComboboxInput',
  inheritAttrs: false,
  props: {
    invalid: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  },
  setup(props, { attrs, slots }) {
    return () =>
      h(
        UiComboboxInput,
        {
          ...attrs,
          'data-invalid': props.invalid ? '' : undefined,
        },
        slots,
      )
  },
})

export const ComboboxChips = defineComponent({
  name: 'ComboboxChips',
  inheritAttrs: false,
  props: {
    surface: { type: String, default: 'base' },
    invalid: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  },
  setup(props, { attrs, slots }) {
    return () =>
      h(
        UiComboboxChips,
        {
          ...attrs,
          'data-surface': props.surface,
          'data-invalid': props.invalid ? '' : undefined,
        },
        slots,
      )
  },
})
